Figures describe Les Arcs/Peisey-Vallandry. Search summaries: 200 km of pistes, 106 runs, 54 lifts (Wikipedia; date not stated); the Les Arcs search also said 'about 200 km'. A tour-operator summary mentioned 7 gondolas and trams and 25 surface lifts (scope unclear, not used). skiresort.info notes the Aiguille Rouge cable car (70 persons) and the Vanoise Express (two-storey, about 187–200 persons per cabin). Linked Paradiski: 425 km, 129 lifts, 19 green / 128 blue / 77 red / 34 black runs.

Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Ski schools (e.g. ESF) and rental shops operate in the resort villages

character: Les Arcs is a group of purpose-built villages (Arc 1600, 1800, 1950 and 2000) above Bourg-Saint-Maurice, linked with Peisey-Vallandry and Villaroger for about 200 km of pistes up to the Aiguille Rouge (3,226 m). The Vanoise Express links it to La Plagne in the Paradiski area (about 425 km), and a funicular connects Bourg-Saint-Maurice station with Arc 1600.
learning: Reference: each Arc village has beginner slopes near the accommodation; confirm beginner-lift access, lessons and which pass tier (Essential, Classic, Premium, Paradiski) a beginner needs.
